lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows along the mid-flank. Centroids exhibit a staggered, quasi-hexagonal distribution between the vertical stripe markers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a rectilinear grid-like matrix across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal features displaying a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient. These features run parallel to the body axis, converging slightly toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a dense population of high-luminance blobs. Spatial frequency is highest near the anterior insertion point, becoming more diffuse toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated low-reflectance silhouette (remora) attached to the flank, situated ventrally to the first dorsal fin.
